current_evidence: The council's validation checklist page links only to this 'Local information requirements' web page (21 sub-pages) and a search found no newer PDF list; neither the page nor its sub-pages shows any adoption or update date.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only 1 requirement fragment ('Req. items 1') out of 21 local information requirements. Missing entirely: Affordable housing statement; Air quality assessment; Biodiversity net gain assessment; Coal mining risk assessment; Crime impact statement; Drainage strategy; Environmental impact assessment; Flood risk assessment; Green belt justification statement; Heritage assessment; Land contamination assessment; Loss of employment land assessment; Noise impact assessment; Planning obligations pro forma statement; Sports and open space impact assessment; Town centre use sequential and impact assessments; Transport assessments/statements and travel plans; Tree survey; VU City 3D model; Outline applications. Grokbot says it read the drainage, flood risk, planning obligations, land contamination and outline pages but extracted nothing from them.
issues.evidence: Local information requirements page lists 21 items, from 'Outline applications' and 'Affordable housing statement' through to 'Tree survey' and 'VU City 3D model'.

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment is missing as a requirement. Only the sequential test is recorded. Source triggers: any development in Flood Zone 3 or Flood Zone 2; any operational development of 1ha or more in Flood Zone 1; development on sites over 0.5ha in Critical Drainage Areas.
issues.evidence: Flood Risk Assessment page: 'Any operational development of 1ha or above in Low Flood Risk Zone 1'; 'Development proposals on sites over 0.5 hectares in size located within Critical Drainage Areas'.

issues.detail: Tree survey is missing. Trigger: all applications where development could affect existing trees, including trees on adjacent land or highways. If unsure, at minimum submit a site plan for desktop review. This applies to householder schemes too.
issues.evidence: Tree survey page: 'All applications where development could affect existing trees. This includes trees on adjacent land or highways.'

issues.detail: Heritage assessment is missing. Triggers: alterations to a listed building; development within or affecting the setting of a conservation area; alterations to a locally listed heritage asset; development within or affecting the setting of a historic park or garden; development in areas of archaeological interest.
issues.evidence: Heritage assessment page: 'Applications that involve alterations to a listed building'; 'Applications within or affecting the setting of a conservation area'.

issues.detail: The only tab item, the biodiversity survey, has no requirement name. Its text runs the designated-site sub-bullets together and stops at 'Any application involving:', so the actual triggers are lost: works in roof spaces, demolition of a building, conversion of a building, and works to cellars, bridges, culverts, large stone walls, caves or mines. It also leaves out quarry or derelict land; development next to a river, canal or other water body; within 250m of a natural pond or reservoir; works to trees or scrub; hedgerow or woodland; invasive species; lighting of churches or listed buildings; floodlighting within 50m of woodland or water; non-householder development in priority habitat; and Greater Manchester BAP habitats.
issues.evidence: Biodiversity survey and reports page: 'Any application involving: Works within the roof space of an existing building; The demolition of a building; The conversion of a building...'

issues.detail: The 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' trigger excerpt opens with a cut-off fragment ('main application)'). It also leaves out the exemptions on the source page: the sequential test is not needed for certain minor developments or for change of use, unless the change is to a highly vulnerable use. The exception test applies only 'if necessary'.
issues.evidence: Flood Risk Assessment page: sequential test 'not necessary for developments wholly in Flood Zone 1'; for change of use, not required 'unless change of use to a highly vulnerable use such as a caravan site'.

issues.detail: Every application type except Full planning is marked '(none) - national requirements only', which is wrong. Salford's local requirements apply to any application that meets the trigger, whatever its type. Householder schemes can trigger tree survey, heritage assessment, flood risk assessment (Flood Zones 2 and 3) and biodiversity survey (roof-space works, demolition). Listed building consent triggers the heritage assessment. The Outline page states that local requirements also apply to outline applications.
issues.evidence: Outline applications page: 'The national and local requirements are also required to be met when the application is in outline form.'

issues.detail: The sequential test was placed under Full planning only, with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named... placed under Full planning'. The source ties it to location (Flood Zones 2 and 3), not to application type, so it also applies to outline schemes and to some changes of use.
issues.evidence: Flood Risk Assessment page: 'For Flood Zones 2 or 3 only'.

issues.detail: Status 'Captured' and Extraction level 'Partial (automated)' overstate what was captured: 1 garbled item out of 21 requirements. The validation checklist page also warns that further documents may be requested that are not on the list, such as agricultural land assessment, daylight/sunlight assessment, wind studies and odour impact assessment. Grokbot recorded none of this.
issues.evidence: Validation checklist page names agricultural land use assessments, daylight/sunlight assessments, wind studies and odour impact assessments as possible extra requirements.

summary: Grokbot's link works and is Salford's current local list. The list is a set of undated web pages, so a null date is correct. However, the extraction is almost empty: 1 garbled biodiversity fragment out of 21 requirements. Every application type except Full planning is wrongly marked as having no local requirements.
